displayPattern: 7-segment display on a *CVC96 or *MVC96 two-stage furnace covered by IOG-2015L, including Amana AMVC96 and ACVC96: EE8. High stage does not run; low stage can still operate. The induced draft blower is running
meaning: High stage pressure switch circuit is closed at the start of the heating cycle.
causes: High stage pressure switch contacts sticking
Short in the pressure switch circuit wiring
diySteps: Low stage heat may still run. EE8 is not the open high-stage switch (EE9)
Technician: diagnose the high stage pressure switch and repair a short in the wiring
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if the furnace will not go to high stage and the display shows EE8.
sourceTitle: Amana and Goodman *CVC96 / *MVC96 two-stage furnace installation instructions (IOG-2015L)
